items.text: Jim Harbaugh said WR Ladd McConkey (rib) won’t practice Wednesday; early negative sign, day-to-day.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; Harbaugh confirms no practice.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday; possible miss or limited Week 2 vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris or other Chargers WRs if OUT.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery to quicken recovery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery confirmed by Rapoport and Schefter.
items.implication: Out minimum 4 games; elevates Bateman/Moore in Ravens WR room.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining Ravens WRs behind Flowers.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not spotted/not practicing Wednesday; left Week 1 early but not serious per prior coach comments.
items.why: Hamstring from Week 1; second issue in weeks.
items.implication: Backup plans needed; high re-aggravation risk.
items.opportunity: Bateman elevated with Lane also out.

items.text: Travis Hunter only 4 offensive snaps Week 1 in specialized package (jet, screens, decoy); never passed LOS on route. Jags clear intention for limited offensive role this year despite draft capital.
items.why: Specialized gadget only; Parker Washington exploding; Meyers extended.
items.implication: Limited fantasy upside short-term; long season but clear hierarchy.
items.opportunity: Brian Thomas Jr / Parker Washington primary.

items.text: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling placed on IR due to ankle; sidelined at least four games.
items.implication: Opens door for Deebo Samuel and others in 49ers WR room.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week on FFHH amid 49ers WR injuries (Stribling IR).
items.why: Opportunity from Stribling IR and 49ers needs.
items.implication: Must-add in most leagues; utilization themes endorsed.

items.text: Week 2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De’Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders. Top adds include Devaughn Vele, Deebo, Kaelon Black.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping + streaming options.
items.implication: Prioritize injury-driven adds; FAAB guidance included.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance Week 2 or 3 but same knee as last year's PCL/bone bruise; DNP Wednesday, day-to-day, not overly serious per reports; possible return this week if feels good, latest Week 4.
items.why: Meniscus procedure; team cautious due to history; Kubiak DNP confirm.
items.implication: Michael Mayer starts until return; monitor practices closely.
items.opportunity: Mayer short-term TE upside if delayed.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant opportunity share in new offense.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage locked; full-grown-man role.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty high-end RB1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att + 6 tgt, 156 yds + 2 TD; Utilization 99 tying Bijan. YBC/YAC improved; every-down player.
items.why: Dominant share and efficiency in new scheme/OL.
items.implication: Top-3 RB prospect profile realizing; bullish ROS.

items.text: Vikings RB Jordan Mason small thumb fracture fixed; short-term IR, should return quickly; DeeJay Dallas signed to 53.
items.opportunity: Aaron Jones clearer lead if not already.

items.text: No Tua Tagovailoa at practice Wednesday; Michael Penix Jr. on adjacent field throwing with coach. Falcons QB uncertainty with Rush also banged up.
items.why: Tua oblique; Penix knee recovery not full.
items.implication: Possible Jack Strand start; streamer alert.
items.opportunity: Strand or Wentz stream if QBs out.

items.text: ETR Rest of Season Top-150 rankings live after Week 1 usage lessons; sizable changes from unexpected roles/injuries. Trade calculator also live.
items.why: Incorporates W1 snaps/routes/targets, coach tendencies, injury fallouts.
items.implication: Use for trades/ROS valuations; not for bottom waivers.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 vs Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Committee despite lead role expectation.
items.why: Split work even without Kamara; low route rate.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further clouds.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller handcuff/stash if Kamara misses.
